exceptions.reason: Opaque recipes are exact evidence-only replays; they are not eligible generated inventory. Normal generation uses a separately authored complete bounds-error bank.
Captured angular integration row has dr instead of dtheta; exclude source from validated inventory and preserve it unchanged. Normal xy_over_r2 output has the correct differential.

difficulty_evidence.easy: Authored same-method constant density disk with unit-magnitude integer slopes; constant angular integral and elementary radial power.
difficulty_evidence.moderate: Authored same-method one linear term x or y with unit-magnitude integer slopes, one familiar trig primitive.
difficulty_evidence.hard: Twelve observed density structures, signed/radical plane metrics; linear families require a^2+b^2 >= 5.

finite_domain.policy: All samplers are bounded. Do not duplicate after exhaustion; report finite-limit and remaining band shortages.

identity_policy: Inventory canonicalizes density, squared surface metric, radius and angular bounds; excludes seed, UUID, answer order, vertical translations and slope-sign-only changes.
